items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Happy Shilling' as a possible friend of the interviewee or associated with 'Tiger Rag', but the interviewee does not respond or confirm any personal relationship.

ctx.x: Let's see, speaking of Tiger Rag, I think Jack Lane once, or maybe it was your friend, trombone player, or lives up in Jefferson, what's the matter? I can't think of it.

Happy Shilling. Happy Shilling. Told about a clarinetist used to play with them, Eshiel Baque. Eshiel. And he might have been part colored or something, but anyway, he was very light. I've heard lots about him.
